[GMO hacking damage - update]

The damage amount officially recognized by XM is 11,849,538 yen.

How likely is it that full compensation will be received from GMO?

I had ChatGPT analyze it, and the assessment was "70-80%".

Three grounds:

① GMO has announced a policy of compensating realized losses from unauthorized trades
② XM confirmed 307 unauthorized trades + the closing of 123 existing positions
③ XM's investigation results have been formally submitted to GMO

The biggest focus is whether the roughly 5.83 million yen from forced closure of existing positions will also be compensated.

Of course, 70-80% is an AI's subjective estimate, not a guarantee.

Will the 11.85 million yen come back? I'll keep publishing any progress.

#GMO #FX #UnauthorizedAccess

GMOから全額補償を受けられる可能性はどの程度あるのか？

もちろん70〜80%はAIの主観的推定で、保証ではありません。
